AgentScript
===========
usage: fmt [--width N] FILE

  --width N  wrap at N columns
  --help     show this text

the substitution is a no-op, so this case is the literal itself: two raw newlines from the banner, a blank line inside the usage block, and an escape-form newline joining them, each of which has to arrive as one character

AgentScript
===========
usage: asl [--width N] FILE

  --width N  wrap at N columns
  --help     show this text
a replacement of equal length, so a target that lost or doubled a newline shifts the whole tail rather than only the substituted word

AgentScript
===========
usage:  [--width N] FILE

  --width N  wrap at N columns
  --help     show this text
the empty replacement: it shortens the line the substitution sits on and must leave every newline around it exactly where it was
